preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of players to select n must be between 3 and 100.
The sum of squares of n over all test cases must not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.description: After processing all matches, the program must output an exclamation mark to indicate the end of a test case.
The total number of matches organized must not exceed 4n^2.
Exactly n players must be selected for the championship.
